description: Make one sound effect from plain words with the ElevenLabs sound-effects model: whooshes, impacts, chimes, clicks, risers, ambiences, foley, anything that is not music and not a voice. Describe the sound (what it is, its attack and tail, its material, its feel), optionally fix its length in seconds (0.5 to 30; leave it out to let the model pick), set loop true for a seamless ambience, and prompt_influence 0 to 1 for how literally to follow the words. For a music bed use generate_sound. Billed per second (a token quote applies) and the file is saved to your library. Returns audio_url, duration_seconds and generation_id.

description.description: The sound in plain words, as long as you like. For example "a glassy futuristic visor powering up, quick rising shimmer into a soft bright chime, clean, no music".

loop.description: Optional. true makes a sound that loops seamlessly (ambiences, textures).

prompt_influence.description: Optional, 0 to 1. Higher follows the words more literally with less variety. Default 0.3.

seconds.description: Optional length, 0.5 to 30 seconds. Leave out to let the sound maker choose from the words.

name: generate_sound_effect
title: Generate Sound Effect
